text: The purpose of this report is to address safety concerns in the area of Holy Trinity Elementary School and it is recommended that the current "No Parking, 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday" regulation, on the west side of Colonel Samuel Smith Park Drive, be amended to create a "Maximum 10 Minute Limit, 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday" parking regulation to address the need for additional drop-off and pick-up space for parents of attending school children. To improve safety, U-turns should also be prohibited on Colonel Samuel Smith Park Drive in the school zone area. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a bus service on Colonel Samuel Smith Park Drive, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing parking prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Colonel Samuel Smith Park Drive between a point 49 metres south of Lake Shore Boulevard West and a point 190 metres south. 2. City Council authorize parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Colonel Samuel Smith Park Drive between a point 49 metres south of Lake Shore Boulevard West to a point 190 metres south. 3. City Council prohibit southbound U-turns at all times, on Colonel Samuel Smith Park Drive between Lake Shore Boulevard West and a point 205 metres south.
